notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on first keeper (Pendlebury per Lighthouse Friends, Conley per Grand Manan Archives) and on Conley's end date (ca. 1844 vs 1874). Concrete tower dated 1915 (LF, archives); the record and Parks Canada's register give 1914. The 1914-15 works entry (source 6) was matched by position in an OCR'd table. The Lighthouse Friends roster has overlapping stints (Harvey to 1916, Daggett from 1915) and was not reconciled. The 1894 LHB passage is OCR'd and the distance is garbled, so omitted. Parks Canada page 14913 and Canadian Register 21059 pages were not readable in full for the construction year; no Canadian source read confirms 1914 vs 1915. Sovereignty dispute only touched as the heritage records state it. No newspaper searches run; thin on the individual keepers' lives. Fact-check 2026-10-27: archives (source 5) say western wooden tower pulled down 1905, eastern cut down after 1915; LF says both demolished; story states the disagreement. 1914-15 works row for Machias Seal Island confirmed on page image (printed p.42). Lawrence Benson dated 1940s (archives) vs 1960s (LF).
